citations.case: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section II (principal diagnosis: condition established after study chiefly responsible for the admission); Section I.B.5 (melena is integral to the bleeding ulcer; K92.1 not coded separately); Section III.B (abnormal findings are not coded unless the provider indicates their clinical significance); Section I.B.16 (code to the highest specificity documented)

coder_notes: H. pylori positive result and the low hemoglobin are both query opportunities; neither is coded from the lab alone. K25.4 is the combination code for chronic gastric ulcer with hemorrhage; no separate K92.2 code. Traps: Coding B96.81 (H. pylori) from a positive stool antigen when the provider never documented H. pylori infection or linked it to the ulcer; coding D62 (acute blood loss anemia) from a hemoglobin of 7.8 without a provider diagnosis of anemia; adding K92.1 (melena) alongside the ulcer-with-hemorrhage code; coding the ulcer without hemorrhage (K25.7) because the gastritis also bled
